title: Symlink-safe scanning, shared agent skills, and folder-scoped rules
summary: The scan command no longer follows symlinks: a link is counted as excluded instead of being read as the file or directory it points at, so a scan of nothing but links can never read as clean and a link cycle cannot recurse forever. Alongside that, agent configuration is consolidated — repository-wide rules move into folder-scoped AGENTS.md files, a shared .agents/skills tree is exposed to Claude Code through a git symlink, and CI gains a skill lint plus a check that the symlink stays a symlink.

nodes.label: osf CLI
nodes.subtitle: osf scan / osf lint
nodes.summary: Parses arguments and dispatches to the scan and lint libraries. Unchanged by this diff, but it is the entry point every scan path below runs through.

nodes.label: scan_paths
nodes.subtitle: pub fn scan_paths(dir, paths, rules, excluder)
nodes.summary: Now threads a skipped-symlink count out of target resolution and re-checks each resolved target with symlink_metadata before reading it, so a link is counted as excluded rather than read.

nodes.label: resolve_scan_targets
nodes.subtitle: returns (targets, skipped)
nodes.summary: Returns the resolved targets together with the number of symlinks skipped. With no paths it still lists git-tracked files and reports zero skipped; with explicit paths it walks them and counts every link it refuses to follow.

nodes.label: collect_files
nodes.subtitle: recursive walk, symlink-aware
nodes.summary: Switched from metadata to symlink_metadata and returns early on a link, incrementing the skipped counter. This is what stops a link that cycles back on an ancestor directory from recursing forever.

nodes.label: Excluder
nodes.subtitle: is_excluded(label)
nodes.summary: The existing path-exclusion filter. Skipped symlinks are folded into the same dropped counter it feeds, so the summary line reports them together.

nodes.label: ScanOutcome
nodes.subtitle: files, excluded
nodes.summary: The result the CLI prints. Its excluded count now includes symlinks, which is what makes a repository of only a symlink report '1 excluded' instead of a clean scan.

nodes.label: git tracked files
nodes.subtitle: crate::git::tracked_files
nodes.summary: Lists the files git tracks in the repository. The no-paths scan path still goes through it and reports zero skipped links.

nodes.label: Working tree
nodes.subtitle: files, directories, symlinks
nodes.summary: The real files on disk. A symlink here is now observed as a link rather than resolved to its target, whether it is a tracked entry, an explicit path, or found mid-walk.

nodes.label: ci.yml
nodes.subtitle: build, test, lint, scan gate
nodes.summary: Gains two steps: one lints every skill under skills/ and .agents/skills/, the other asserts .claude/skills is a git symlink pointing at ../.agents/skills.

nodes.label: Check the skills
nodes.subtitle: osf lint skill --format human
nodes.summary: Enumerates every tracked SKILL.md directory and lints them all on every run, since skills are few and cheap to check.

nodes.label: Check the Claude Code skills link
nodes.subtitle: git ls-files -s .claude/skills
nodes.summary: Fails the build unless git records .claude/skills with mode 120000 and readlink resolves it to ../.agents/skills, with a Windows fix hint in the error.

nodes.label: .agents/skills
nodes.subtitle: shared skill tree
nodes.summary: The one home for skills every coding agent shares. Four new skills land here: adding-an-osf-command, filing-an-issue, opening-a-pull-request and reviewing-a-pull-request.

nodes.label: .claude/skills
nodes.subtitle: symlink to ../.agents/skills
nodes.summary: A git symlink, mode 120000, so Claude Code reads the shared tree instead of drifting as its own copy. The new CI step exists to keep it that way.

nodes.label: skills/
nodes.subtitle: show-me, pr-outline
nodes.summary: The skills this repository ships to adopters. Credit lines move out of the SKILL.md files into THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and the folder READMEs, so a skill holds only what an agent acts on.

nodes.label: Folder AGENTS.md files
nodes.subtitle: crates/, .github/workflows/
nodes.summary: Repository-wide rules are split into folder-scoped files: crates/AGENTS.md carries code layout, language and the four pre-push commands; .github/workflows/AGENTS.md carries the secret-handling and action-pinning rules.

nodes.label: scan.rs tests
nodes.subtitle: symlink cases
nodes.summary: Five new cases cover a tracked symlinked directory, a repository of only a symlink, an explicit symlinked path, a link found mid-walk, and a link cycle. TempRepo gains a symlink helper that works on Unix and Windows.

edges.label: scan
edges.summary: The CLI hands the scan its paths, rules and excluder.

edges.label: (targets, skipped)
edges.summary: The call now returns a skipped-link count alongside the targets, which seeds the dropped counter.

edges.label: walk, count links
edges.summary: Each explicit path is walked with the shared skipped counter, so links found anywhere in the walk are counted.

edges.label: tracked_files
edges.summary: With no paths given, the target list still comes from git and reports zero skipped links.

edges.label: symlink_metadata
edges.summary: The walk now stats with symlink_metadata and returns early on a link, so a link is never descended into and a cycle terminates.

edges.label: read file bytes
edges.summary: Before reading, each resolved target is re-checked with symlink_metadata; a link is counted as dropped and skipped.

edges.label: is_excluded
edges.summary: The existing exclusion filter still runs first; symlink skips add to the same dropped counter.

edges.label: excluded count
edges.summary: The outcome's excluded count now includes skipped symlinks, which is what the '1 excluded' assertion in the tests reads.

edges.label: step
edges.summary: The workflow gains a step that lints every tracked skill directory.

edges.label: step
edges.summary: The workflow gains a step that fails unless .claude/skills is a symlink to ../.agents/skills.

edges.label: mode 120000
edges.summary: The check reads the git index mode and the link target, so the symlink cannot silently become a copied directory.

edges.label: git ls-files
edges.summary: The step enumerates skills/*/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md and lints each directory.

edges.label: ../.agents/skills
edges.summary: Claude Code reads .claude/skills, which resolves to the shared tree, so one edit reaches every agent.

edges.label: rules per folder
edges.summary: The root AGENTS.md now delegates folder rules to each folder's own AGENTS.md, and the skills READMEs point at the same notices file.

edges.label: symlink cases
edges.summary: Five new tests drive scan_paths with symlinked directories, explicit links and a cycle, asserting files stay empty and excluded is 1.
